supported_workflows: Text-to-optimization benchmark for retail supply chain planning
Solver-validated MILP generation for inventory, assortment and logistics problems
supported_questions: Generate an MILP for multi-period inventory with seasonal demand and perishability
How should a retailer allocate product substitution and promotion decisions?
What is the optimal transshipment plan across distribution centres?
Can this omni-channel scenario with reverse logistics be formulated as a MILP?

overlap_with.nature: Both are retail-related, but this dataset is optimisation/logic-focused while retail_product_search_eval is search/relevance-focused
Both are supply chain; this dataset provides synthetic optimisation problems, raw_rag_candidates provides regulatory and operational reference text

weak_content: Scenarios are synthetic; while solver-validated, they may not capture all real-world operational constraints
Strong focus on retail shelf-life/inventory; coverage of procurement or customs compliance is limited
primary_recommendation: Primary source for supply-chain optimisation and text-to-MILP evaluation. Complement with supply_chain_raw_rag_candidates for regulatory and logistics reference material.
